def prepare_reading_business_assessment(text: str, source_relations: dict, *, ref_text=None,
        source_roles: SourceAssertionRoles | None = None,
        relation_bindings: tuple[bool, ...] = (), grammar_work_budget=None) -> ReadingBusinessAssessment:
    """One charged exact-view assessment shared by every reading consumer."""
    legacy_facts: dict[str, OperatingFact] = {}
    operating_observed: list[bool] = []
    def recognize(value):
        if value not in legacy_facts:
            prepared = prepare_business_observation(value)
            legacy_facts[value] = prepared.fact
            operating_observed.append(prepared.operating.eligible or prepared.specific_industry)
        return legacy_facts[value]
    from company_wiki.document_understanding.operating_states.assertion_roles import prepare_source_assertions
    source_roles = source_roles if source_roles is not None else prepare_source_assertions(
        text, work_budget=grammar_work_budget)
    original_text = text
    from company_wiki.document_understanding.structure.table_purpose import accounting_field
    def accounting_text(clause):
        return bool(_SOURCE_ACCOUNTING.search(clause) or accounting_field(clause))
    causal_observations: dict[str, bool] = {}
    metric_observations: _MetricObservations = {}
    relation_observations: dict[str, _ReadingRelationObservation] = {}
    statement_scope = prepare_source_statement_scope(text, source_roles, accounting_text=accounting_text,
        causal_relation=lambda value: _observed_causal_relation(
            value, causal_observations, metric_observations=metric_observations),
        measurement_relation=lambda value: _business_revenue_measure(
            value, metric_observations=metric_observations),
        quantified_argument=source_has_operating_measure, grammar_work_budget=grammar_work_budget,
        business_relation=lambda value: _independent_reading_relation(value,
            causal_observations=causal_observations, metric_observations=metric_observations,
            prepared=relation_observations),
        scope_relation=lambda value: _reading_source_scope(value,
            causal_observations=causal_observations, metric_observations=metric_observations,
            prepared=relation_observations))
    text, fact_roles = statement_scope.text, statement_scope.fact_roles or statement_scope.roles
    if statement_scope.suppressed:
        # Keep the source relations/refs verbatim. Only an assertion observed
        # inside a statement sentence can retain its existing binding proof.
        def assertion_text(relation):
            refs = relation.get('assertion_refs', ())
            return ' '.join(ref_text(ref) if ref_text is not None else
                            original_text[ref['char_start']:ref['char_end']] for ref in refs)
        relation_bindings = tuple(bound and statement_assertion_key(assertion_text(relation))
            in statement_scope.assertion_keys for bound, relation in
            zip(relation_bindings, source_relations.get('relations', ())))
    observed: list[bool] = []
    description = _purpose_fact(_detect_reading_business_fact(text, recognize, source_roles=fact_roles,
                                                            causal_observations=causal_observations,
                                                            metric_observations=metric_observations,
                                                            relation_observations=relation_observations,
                                                            payload_observations=observed),
                                source_purpose(text, prepared=fact_roles))
    background = any(clause.operating and clause.independent_payload is False and not clause.rule_purpose
                     for clause in statement_scope.roles.clauses)
    if (not background and not text.strip() and statement_scope.roles.clauses
            and not statement_scope.financial_context_keys
            and not any(clause.rule_purpose for clause in statement_scope.roles.clauses)):
        # The compatibility source reader has always recalled a complete
        # generic operating description. No clause recognizer ran on this
        # empty material view; reuse the original broad source-recall owner
        # once, then explicitly keep its value at background (not payload).
        background = _business_fact(original_text).eligible
    if not description.eligible and background:
        # Complete generic source content remains recallable background. This
        # is not independent material, business relevance or an event proof.
        description = OperatingFact(True, ('core_business',), ('operating_description_unknown',),
                                    1, False, 'operating')
    from .narrative_operating_resources import operating_resource_relations
    resource_purposes: dict[str, str] = {}
    purpose_roles = {statement_assertion_key(clause.text): clause for clause in fact_roles.clauses}

    def resource_purpose(value: str) -> str:
        key = statement_assertion_key(value)
        if key not in resource_purposes:
            clause = purpose_roles.get(key)
            prepared = replace(fact_roles, clauses=(clause,)) if clause is not None else None
            resource_purposes[key] = source_purpose(value, prepared=prepared, work_budget=grammar_work_budget)
        return resource_purposes[key]

    resource_reasons = operating_resource_relations(_reading_text(text), purpose_for=resource_purpose)
    recognition_scope = named_recognition_scope(_reading_text(text))
    fact_roles = replace(fact_roles, bound_payload=bool(
        fact_roles.bound_payload or any(relation_bindings) or any(observed)
        or any(operating_observed) or resource_reasons or recognition_scope
        or revenue_recognition_mechanism(text)))
    fact = project_reading_business_fact(original_text, source_relations, description=description, ref_text=ref_text,
        source_roles=fact_roles, relation_bindings=relation_bindings,
        resource_reasons=resource_reasons, recognition_scope=recognition_scope)
    source_roles = replace(statement_scope.roles, bound_payload=fact_roles.bound_payload)
    financial = reading_financial_only(text, fact, recognize=recognize)
    # The old prepared use is monotonic input to the broader quote capability,
    # not a second scan or an invitation to mutate operating/state proofs.
    from .narrative_support_use import source_support_use, source_narrative_relevance
    existing_use = source_support_use(text, fact=fact, financial_only=financial,
                                     source_roles=source_roles)
    existing_relevant = source_narrative_relevance(fact=fact, source_roles=source_roles)
    passage = prepare_source_passage(original_text, source_roles, purpose=fact.purpose, financial_only=financial,
        accounting_text=accounting_text,
        non_operating_purposes=NON_OPERATING_PURPOSES, existing_use=existing_use,
        existing_relevant=existing_relevant, statement_scope=statement_scope,
        existing_fact_proof=bool(fact.eligible and set(fact.reasons) - UNRESOLVED_READING_REASONS),
        grammar_work_budget=grammar_work_budget)
    # A finance label in a mixed scope is not proof that an unprocessed
    # independent passage contains no business. Reuse the existing unknown
    # financial axis rather than manufacturing a finance-only result.
    classified_financial = (None if not passage.assessment_complete else False if passage.relevant
                            else financial or passage.financial_only)
    return ReadingBusinessAssessment(fact, classified_financial, source_roles, passage, description)

"""R5 independent source-contract probes; no production materials/models."""
import json
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from company_wiki.source_catalog import narrative_business_policy as owner
from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_business_disclosures import reading_material_value
from company_wiki.document_understanding.operating_states.assertion_roles import prepare_source_assertions

WT = Path('C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/company-wiki/tmp/architecture-r2')
assert Path(owner.__file__).resolve() == (WT / 'src/company_wiki/source_catalog/narrative_business_policy.py').resolve()
ROWS = []
NO_EVENT = {'operating_milestone', 'operating_current_state', 'operating_quantity', 'operating_metric_change', 'business_revenue_measure'}


def assess(text):
    result = owner.prepare_reading_business_assessment(text, {'relations': []})
    ROWS.append({'text': text, 'fact': asdict(result.fact), 'text_fact': asdict(result.text_fact),
                 'payload': result.source_roles.independent_payload,
                 'source_scope': result.source_roles.source_scope,
                 'value': reading_material_value(result.fact, source_roles=result.source_roles),
                 'passage': asdict(result.passage), 'roles': asdict(result.source_roles)})
    (Path(__file__).parent / 'observations.json').write_text(json.dumps(ROWS, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    return result


@pytest.mark.parametrize('text', [
    'Our platform supports remarkable ambitions.',
    'Our platform supports promising possibilities.',
    'Our platform supports unfamiliar technical endeavours.',
    'We aim to pursue luminous horizons.',
    'Our platform plans to support remarkable ambitions.',
    'Our platform supports wondrous tomorrows.',
    'We aim to pursue plausible trajectories.',
])
def test_weak_unknowns_do_not_become_material_or_business_by_exclusion(text):
    result = assess(text)
    assert result.source_roles.independent_payload is None and not result.source_roles.bound_payload
    assert result.passage.use == 'unresolved' and not result.passage.relevant
    assert reading_material_value(result.fact, source_roles=result.source_roles) == 'description'
    assert not NO_EVENT.intersection(result.fact.reasons)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('text', [
    'Our services cover mireto, davran and silnex.',
    '我们的服务涵盖甲砂、乙璜与丙辕。',
    'Our brand portfolio comprises Quenlo, Vassir and Rheniq.',
])
def test_closed_unseen_member_names_are_material_without_world_event(text):
    result = assess(text)
    assert result.fact.eligible and result.source_roles.independent_payload is True
    assert reading_material_value(result.fact, source_roles=result.source_roles) == 'meaningful_fact'
    assert result.passage.use == 'support' and result.passage.relevant
    assert not NO_EVENT.intersection(result.fact.reasons)
    assert owner.detect_reading_business_fact(text) == result.text_fact


@pytest.mark.parametrize('text', [
    'We plan to update our service platform, but the release date remains uncertain.',
    '公司计划更新服务平台，但具体计划仍未确定。',
])
def test_qualitative_plan_remains_material_and_keeps_its_limitation(text):
    result = assess(text)
    assert result.fact.eligible and 'operating_plan' in result.fact.reasons
    assert reading_material_value(result.fact, source_roles=result.source_roles) == 'meaningful_fact'
    assert result.passage.use == 'support' and result.passage.relevant
    assert not NO_EVENT.intersection(result.fact.reasons)
    # Roles are normalized semantic text; terminal punctuation belongs to the
    # unchanged EvidenceSpan/raw quote, not the role's matching identity.
    assert ''.join(clause.text for clause in result.source_roles.clauses).replace(' ', '').strip(' .。') == text.replace(' ', '').strip(' .。')


@pytest.mark.parametrize('text', [
    'Commercial usage growth: sum of revenue growth plus changes in deferred revenue.',
    'Our remaining performance obligation: commercial revenue allocated to remaining customer services, including amounts billed in future periods.',
])
def test_source_definition_is_useful_basis_without_an_observed_metric(text):
    result = assess(text)
    assert result.text_fact.eligible and 'reporting_metric_definition' in result.text_fact.reasons
    assert not NO_EVENT.intersection(result.fact.reasons)
    assert result.passage.use == 'support' and result.passage.relevant
    assert reading_material_value(result.fact, source_roles=result.source_roles) == 'meaningful_fact'


@pytest.mark.parametrize('text', [
    'Operating income rose 11% because of excellent financial performance.',
    '因为财务表现良好，公司营业利润增长18.1%。',
    'Which services cover mireto and davran',
    'Template: Our services cover mireto, davran and silnex.',
    'Our services cover mireto, davran and',
    '我们的服务涵盖甲砂、乙璜与',
])
def test_financial_question_template_and_open_roster_do_not_gain_support(text):
    result = assess(text)
    assert result.passage.use != 'support' and not result.passage.relevant
    assert not NO_EVENT.intersection(result.fact.reasons)


def test_unrecognised_manufacturing_argument_is_relevant_but_not_qualified():
    from unit.du11_production.test_source_information_binding import session_for, unit_id
    for text in ['We do not manufacture KQ-56.', 'The supplier does not manufacture JV-9.']:
        session, budget = session_for([text])
        uid = unit_id(0)
        fact = session.fact(uid)
        passage = session.source_passage(uid)
        assert passage.use == 'unresolved' and passage.relevant
        assert session.engine.unknown_argument(uid) and not any(session.engine.relation_bindings(uid))
        assert not NO_EVENT.intersection(fact.reasons)
        used = budget.used
        assert session.fact(uid) is fact and session.source_passage(uid) is passage
        assert used == budget.used


def test_text_and_production_resource_views_share_preparation_without_legacy_extension():
    from company_wiki.resource_budget import WorkBudget
    text = 'We employed 1,641 software engineers at June 30.'
    result = owner.prepare_reading_business_assessment(text, {'relations': []}, grammar_work_budget=WorkBudget(1000000))
    assert 'operating_resource_stock' in result.fact.reasons
    assert not {'operating_resource_stock', 'operating_resource_allocation'} & set(result.text_fact.reasons)
    assert owner.detect_reading_business_fact(text) == result.text_fact


def test_resource_purpose_precharges_same_account_and_session_reuse_is_free(monkeypatch):
    from company_wiki.source_catalog import narrative_source_purpose as purpose
    from company_wiki.document_understanding.operating_states import assertion_roles as roles
    from company_wiki.resource_budget import WorkBudget, WorkBudgetExceeded
    from company_wiki.document_normalization.text_matching import matching_reading_text
    from unit.du11_production.test_source_information_binding import session_for, unit_id
    value = 'We invested USD 18.4 million in research and development.'
    real = purpose.prepare_source_assertions
    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        pytest.fail('unaffordable purpose fallback must not scan source assertions')
    with monkeypatch.context() as m:
        m.setattr(purpose, 'prepare_source_assertions', forbidden)
        cost = roles.SOURCE_DESCRIPTION_SCAN_PASSES * len(matching_reading_text(value))
        with pytest.raises(WorkBudgetExceeded):
            purpose.source_purpose(value, work_budget=WorkBudget(cost - 1))
    accounts = []
    real_purpose = owner.source_purpose
    def observed(text, **kwargs):
        if 'work_budget' in kwargs:
            accounts.append(kwargs['work_budget'])
        return real_purpose(text, **kwargs)
    monkeypatch.setattr(owner, 'source_purpose', observed)
    session, budget = session_for([value + ' We employed 1,641 software engineers at June 30.'])
    fact = session.fact(unit_id(0))
    assert 'operating_resource_allocation' in fact.reasons
    assert accounts and all(account is budget for account in accounts)
    visits, used = len(accounts), budget.used
    assert session.fact(unit_id(0)) is fact
    session.source_passage(unit_id(0))
    assert len(accounts) == visits and budget.used == used


def test_public_selector_preserves_roster_but_not_a_separate_financial_total():
    from unit.document_understanding_selection.test_reading_production_selection import _document, _unit
    from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_evidence import select_narrative_evidence
    roster = 'Our services cover mireto, davran and silnex.'
    finance = 'Net income was $19 million.'
    parsed = _document(_unit(finance, kind='html_paragraph'), _unit(roster, paragraph=1, kind='html_paragraph'))
    selected = select_narrative_evidence(parsed, title='Annual report', existing_kind='annual_report', selector_version='0.9.0')
    assert {span.raw_text for span in selected.evidence_spans} == {roster}
    assert selected.reading_context['source_processing_complete']
    # This structural fixture deliberately lacks carrier/scope inventory
    # metadata; successful source assessment cannot forge complete cache proof.
    assert selected.reading_dependencies['status'] == 'partial'
    assert {'INVENTORY_INCOMPLETE', 'INVENTORY_NOT_COMPLETE'} <= {
        row['code'] for row in selected.reading_dependencies['diagnostics']}

import ast
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path('C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/company-wiki')
WT=ROOT/'tmp/architecture-r2'
OUT=ROOT/'tmp/k5'
REPORTS=ROOT/'docs/plans/du11-source-closure-2026-10-18/review/architecture-quality-20261101/implementation-results'
def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=WT)
manifest_path=REPORTS/'R6-r5-freeze-manifest.json'
manifest_bytes=manifest_path.read_bytes()
assert sha(manifest_bytes)=='d45fc6875e411b2e2911e78e838b84a47af98fdf27c35c50438e5bc03b863650'
manifest=json.loads(manifest_bytes)
spy=json.loads((REPORTS/'R6-R5-budget-spies.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
expected={**manifest,spy['path']:spy['sha256']}
head=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
assert head=='10767b86318e63094c2bb49451447c9aedffc32c'
checks={}
for path,wanted in expected.items():
    data=(WT/path).read_bytes(); blob=git('show',f'{head}:{path}')
    checks[path]={'raw_sha256':sha(data),'expected':wanted,'raw_match':sha(data)==wanted,
                  'git_blob_sha256':sha(blob),'git_lf_match':data.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')==blob}
assert len(checks)==13 and all(c['raw_match'] and c['git_lf_match'] for c in checks.values())
old_review=json.loads((REPORTS/'R6-independent-source-contract-r5.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
unchanged={}
for path in old_review['original_old_tests_unchanged_from_a684']:
    if path==spy['path']: continue
    old=git('show',f'2b0787dc:{path}'); current=git('show',f'{head}:{path}')
    unchanged[path]={'unchanged':old==current,'git_blob_sha256':sha(current)}
assert len(unchanged)==12 and all(row['unchanged'] for row in unchanged.values())
author=json.loads((REPORTS/'R6-source-contract-r5.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
runs=[]
def walk(x):
    if isinstance(x,dict):
        if isinstance(x.get('junit'),str) and isinstance(x.get('sha256'),str):
            runs.append(x)
        for v in x.values(): walk(v)
    elif isinstance(x,list):
        for v in x: walk(v)
walk(author)
run_checks=[]
for run in runs:
    path=Path(run['junit']); path=path if path.is_absolute() else WT/path
    data=path.read_bytes()
    assert sha(data)==run['sha256'], str(path)
    run_checks.append({'path':str(path),'sha256':sha(data),'tests':run.get('tests'),
                       'failures':run.get('failures'),'errors':run.get('errors'),'seconds':run.get('seconds')})
source=(WT/'src/company_wiki/source_catalog/narrative_business_policy.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
tree=ast.parse(source)
detect=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='detect_reading_business_fact')
prepare=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='prepare_reading_business_assessment')
data={'head':head,'branch':git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip(),
      'manifest_sha256':sha(manifest_bytes),'frozen_files':checks,'original_12_oracles_unchanged':unchanged,
      'root_spy_diff':git('diff','2b0787dc',head,'--',spy['path']).decode(),
      'author_receipt_sha256':sha((REPORTS/'R6-source-contract-r5.json').read_bytes()),
      'historical_runs':run_checks,'shared_entrypoint':ast.get_source_segment(source,detect),
      'prepared_projection':ast.get_source_segment(source,prepare),
      'git_status':git('status','--short').decode().strip(),
      'excluded':'T3 tests/unit/document_understanding_note_scope and foreign hook mode; not reviewed/staged'}
(OUT/'seal.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'head':head,'seal_matches':len(checks),'old_oracles':len(unchanged),'author_junit_sha_verified':len(run_checks)},ensure_ascii=False))
